errors.text_span: 其对应左侧轴的数值约为360000至400000之间
errors.evidence: The shortest bars in early July and late August correspond to values closer to 200,000–300,000, not 360,000–400,000 as stated.
The tallest bar in mid-July corresponds to a value of approximately 1,400,000, not exceeding 1,600,000 as stated.
The machine-generated description does not explicitly state the chart's purpose of showing the relationship between daily new COVID-19 cases and related news media reports.
The description does not mention the observed synchronization and lag between peaks in case numbers and news reports, which is highlighted in the reference.
The description does not mention the weekly intervals on the x-axis, which are explicitly labeled in the chart.
The description does not mention the step intervals of 200,000 for the left y-axis and 1,000 for the right y-axis.
The description does not mention the lack of sorting or grouping in the bar chart, which is explicitly noted in the reference.
